title: VaCuus: ultra-optimized multithreaded web UI plugin for UE (Win/Linux/Mac)
description: Gameface-class HTML/web UI middleware as a UE plugin for PC platforms. Top priority: UI rendering/layout must never stall UE game or render threads — off-thread layout+paint, GPU texture sharing, minimal copies. Closest commercial analog: Coherent Gameface.

title: FVaCuusEngine lifetime: function-local static -> module/subsystem ownership
description: T3 concern: singleton via function-local static destroyed at static teardown. M2 threading restructure should tie ownership to UVaCuusSubsystem/module lifecycle.

title: Idle short-circuit: skip Record/publish when RmlUi has no dirty state
description: RmlUi Context::Render re-records every frame (no dirty tracking) — M1 publishes ~0.06ms Record + 0.03ms Replay every frame even for static UI. M2 UI-thread loop should detect no-op frames (RmlUi dirty flags / document change tracking) and publish nothing, activating the spec §5 idle model (composite-only, measured 0.004ms).

title: Async LoadTexture (spec §5): header-probe sync + task decode + RHIAsyncCreateTexture2D
description: M1 deviation: LoadTexture decodes synchronously on calling thread. Spec §5 design: probe image header sync for dimensions, decode on task, upload async; draws render transparent until ready. Land with UI-thread migration.

title: FileInterface: exact-EOF Tell() off-by-one on Linux (FFileHandleUnix clamp)
description: Inherited quirk found in Task 3 re-review: seek to Target==FileSize passes our range check but FFileHandleUnix::Seek read-mode clamps to FileSize-1, so Tell() underreports at exact-EOF boundary. Linux-only, benign. Options: clamp-and-track position ourselves or document. Address in M2 alongside UI-thread file loading.

title: Spike (variant B validation): Linux opaque-FD GL<->Vulkan shared texture into UE 5.8.1
description: 1-day spike, all prerequisites verified on this machine (RTX 3090 Ti, NVIDIA 610.43.03): allocate exportable VkImage (OPAQUE_FD) on UE VkDevice via IVulkanDynamicRHI, wrap with RHICreateTexture2DFromResource, import into a surfaceless GL context via GL_EXT_memory_object_fd + glTexStorageMem2DEXT, render gradient, sync via exported semaphore, sample in a Slate widget. Success: correct pixels, no validation errors, no game-thread wait. Protocol details in docs/research/2026-07-29-webui-middleware.md and agent report (cef-3).
